# Identity Function

> Evaluate the [identity function][identity-function] of a half-precision floating-point number.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var identity = require( '@stdlib/number/float16/base/identity' );
```

#### identity( x )

Evaluates the [identity function][identity-function] for a half-precision floating-point number.

```javascript
var v = identity( -1.0 );
// returns -1.0

v = identity( 2.0 );
// returns 2.0

v = identity( 0.0 );
// returns 0.0

v = identity( -0.0 );
// returns -0.0

v = identity( NaN );
// returns NaN
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var toFloat16 = require( '@stdlib/number/float64/base/to-float16' );
var uniform = require( '@stdlib/random/array/uniform' );
var map = require( '@stdlib/array/base/map' );
var logEachMap = require( '@stdlib/console/log-each-map' );
var identity = require( '@stdlib/number/float16/base/identity' );

// Create an array of random half-precision floating-point numbers:
var x = map( uniform( 100, -50.0, 50.0 ), toFloat16 );

// Evaluate the identity function for each number:
logEachMap( 'x: %0.4f => %0.4f', x, identity );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<!-- C usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

### Usage

```c
#include "stdlib/number/float16/base/identity.h"
```

#### stdlib_base_float16_identity( x )

Evaluates the identity function for a half-precision floating-point number.

```c
#include "stdlib/number/float16/ctor.h"

stdlib_float16_t y = stdlib_base_float16_identity( 2.0 );
// returns 2.0
```

The function accepts the following arguments:

-   **x**: `[in] stdlib_float16_t` input value.

```c
#include "stdlib/number/float16/ctor.h"

stdlib_float16_t stdlib_base_float16_identity( const stdlib_float16_t x );
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- C API usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

### Examples

```c
#include "stdlib/number/float16/base/identity.h"
#include "stdlib/number/float32/base/to_float16.h"
#include "stdlib/number/float16/base/to_float32.h"
#include "stdlib/number/float16/ctor.h"
#include <stdio.h>

int main( void ) {
    const float x[] = { 3.14f, -3.14f, 0.0f, 0.0f/0.0f };

    stdlib_float16_t v;
    stdlib_float16_t y;
    int i;
    for ( i = 0; i < 4; i++ ) {
        v = stdlib_base_float32_to_float16( x[ i ] );
        y = stdlib_base_float16_identity( v );
        printf( "f(%f) = %f\n", stdlib_base_float16_to_float32( v ), stdlib_base_float16_to_float32( y ) ); 
    }
}
```

</section>
